title: Australian Zesty Custard Pie
description: A classic dessert that combines the smoothness of custard with a zesty twist.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the custard and zesty filling.
Pour the custard mixture into the pie crust.
Dot the top of the filling with the softened butter.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and sugar.
Pour the egg mixture over the filling.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.
Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before serving.
